correctness.rationale: Invertibility extends every T^(mk)-fixed state to an mk-periodic word satisfying x_n=x_{n-k}+1[x_{n-1}!=0]. Organize m cyclic rows and k columns: each column difference Dy equals the prior column support mask, rotated at wrap, so telescoping forces binary mask weight divisible by 3. For m=6,7 enumerate all admissible binary masks up to cyclic rotation and all three lifts y_t=a+sum_{i<=t}b_i mod3; retain successor masks also of weight multiple 3. Independently implemented the full quotient mask graphs (6 vertices at m6 and 7 at m7) and verified all nonzero vertices are acyclic, with only zero-loop closed walk. Cyclic rotation at wrap preserves reachability. Hence every mk-periodic word is zero uniformly for all k, not inferred from finite k checks. Direct enumerations k=2..9 also each give one fixed state at both multipliers; T_2 has an 8-cycle at the known endpoint.
